questions.prompt: Confirm the design thesis for this goal.
questions.description: From grill + /design skill. This is a product/tool catalog surface (not marketing SaaS): premium technical register, balanced density, premium micro-motion, distinctive type + mono prompts. Signature move: command palette + refined recipe workspace that feels like the definitive prompt-engineering handbook.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Accept thesis as written (ultimate PE guide/catalog; premium technical; balanced density; palette+browse; shadcn/Tailwind rebuild).

questions.prompt: Confirm scope and stack decisions from grilling.
questions.description: In: full web shell + deep interactions; Tailwind v4 latest + shadcn/ui + helpful React libs; product-surface free (layouts/labels/helpers); theme system+toggle; command palette + page browse; distinctive webfonts; DESIGN.md rewrite; desktop+mobile proof. Out: fake catalog content; invent SEO schema; analytics/auth/backend; README recipe body rewrites; catalog YAML content inventing.

questions.prompt: How should /design be applied during execution?
questions.description: Locks the agents design skill into the goal: multi-agent design waves, design thesis gate, shadcn/Tailwind-v4 references, accessibility/motion lanes, Chrome rendered proof (desktop+mobile), design scanner, no live installs without explicit auth.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Full /design process: Parallel Design Team + System + Polish; audit/inventory first; merge captain; rendered proof gate mandatory.

options.label: Single-agent design polish with proof only
Separate audit goal first, then polish goal

questions.prompt: What is the React library budget beyond Tailwind + shadcn?
questions.description: You asked for any helpful libs. Need a guardrail so we do not dependency-sprawl.
questions.recommendedAnswer: shadcn/Radix stack essentials + cmdk command palette + theme persistence helper + motion only if reduced-motion-safe; avoid heavy chart/3D/state frameworks.

options.label: Optional motion lib only if reduced-motion safe

questions.prompt: Primary brand accent for the ultimate catalog identity?
questions.description: Lane colors can remain multi-hue. Choose the primary accent for links, focus, CTAs, hero energy.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Deep electric blue research accent (evolve current #0a56f0) with refined neutrals — authoritative engineering, not neon SaaS.

options.label: Near-mono ink; accent only on CTAs

questions.description: Grill chose C: visual + interaction excellence + showcase/eval + DESIGN.md SSOT. /design requires desktop+mobile Chrome proof, a11y snapshot, reduced-motion, build/tests.

questions.description: Protect research-catalog integrity while allowing aggressive UI rebuild.
questions.recommendedAnswer: No fake catalog content/claims; no invented SEO schema; no analytics/auth/backend; no README recipe body rewrites; preserve catalog/ SSOT; a11y not optional; reduced-motion respected.
